summary: Defined model-profile-pack contract with stub/local baseline, remote-optional policy gating, secret-handle-only credentials and mandatory ModelBroker routing.
acceptance_evidence: ModelProfilePackV1 requires model-profile-pack coordinates and at least one profile.
Baseline provider modes must include stub or local; remote providers are optional only.
RemoteOptional profiles require a policy gate.
Credential references must be single-token secret:// handles; raw token/password-like values are rejected.
direct_provider_execution_allowed=false and broker_required=true preserve ModelBroker authority.

commands.summary: 18 ecosystem-filtered runtime contract tests passed, including model profile pack fail-closed coverage.
Release gate passed with ecosystem replay and QEMU runtime smoke included.

blocked_shortcuts: Remote model is not required for boot, replay or release gates.
Model profile pack cannot embed raw credentials.
Model profile pack cannot route workflow execution around ModelBroker.
promotion_impact: AgentOS can now manage model routing as ecosystem metadata while preserving local-first baseline runtime behavior.
